responsibility: Implements the Solaris-specific Rust frontend target hook initializer by defining TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It contributes the Rust target metadata for Solaris builds—unix family, solaris OS, sun vendor, and empty environment—through rust_add_target_info and binds that hook into targetrustm. This file is the Rust-language OS-identification companion to the broader Solaris configuration in sol2.h/sol2.cc.
